page_title: BRE 2-3 PSG | Brest v PSG 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Gianluigi Donnarumma leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest).
90+4' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+3' Lilian Brassier (Brest) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' That will be all from Kylian Mbappe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nordi Mukiele (Paris SG).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Jerome Brisard has issued a yellow card to Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG).
89' 2 - 3 Goal 2:3! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

89' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Marco Bizot anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
88' Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
88' Marco Bizot (Brest) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Jerome Brisard pulls out a yellow card.
88' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
87' Jonas Martin (Brest) gets a yellow card. The referee Jerome Brisard made the right call.
87' Yellow card! It's like Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Jerome Brisard agrees and books him.
86' The expression of the referee Jerome Brisard is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Lilian Brassier (Brest) is shown a yellow card.
86' The Paris SG players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
86' Referee Jerome Brisard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Paris SG. Let’s see what happens!
84' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Steve Mounie will be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Romain Del Castillo will be replaced by Achraf Dari (Brest).
82' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris SG comes to nothing.

76' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Paris SG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
74' It's time for a substitution. Vitinha (Paris SG) comes on in place of Kang-In Lee.
73' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jerome Brisard signals.
72' A substitution has been made. Jeremy Le Douaron goes off and Martin Satriano (Brest) comes on.
71' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Martin (Brest) replacing Mahdi Camara.

70' Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
69' PENALTY APPEAL by Paris SG, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

67' Ambitious effort from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
65' Substitution. Hugo Magnetti makes his way off the pitch and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes on as his replacement.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) replaces Bradley Barcola.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) replaces Goncalo Ramos.
62' Ooh that was close! Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
60' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
58' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Lilian Brassier (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
58' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
57' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Romain Del Castillo (Brest), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

57' Mahdi Camara (Brest) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Danilo Pereira (Paris SG) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Mahdi Camara (Brest) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
52' 2 - 2 Romain Del Castillo takes the corner and Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:2.
52' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
51' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Brest will have an opportunity.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Brest.
49' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Paris SG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. Paris SG win a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+2' The corner kick from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
45+1' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. Brest win a corner kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Kenny Lala showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Steve Mounie (Brest) gets onto the scoresheets by sweetly heading it inside the left post – 1:2.
42' Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) is able to continue to play.
41' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

41' A sweet pass finds Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Marco Bizot is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and Paris SG manage to earn a corner.
39' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Jerome Brisard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
38' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
36' PENALTY APPEAL after Bradley Locko (Brest) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
35' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Kang-In Lee (Paris SG).
33' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris SG.
30' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
30' Mahdi Camara (Brest) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Good work from Brest as they win a corner.

28' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Marco Bizot had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:2.
27' Mahdi Camara (Brest) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
24' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
22' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

21' Marco Bizot pulls off a great save to deny Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The ball goes out of play. Paris SG are awarded a corner kick.
21' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) heads on.
19' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) takes the corner with a short pass.

19' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Paris SG have a corner.
18' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) attempts to find Kang-In Lee, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.

16' 0 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) and Bradley Barcola gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top left corner. 0:1.

16' Lilian Brassier (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
15' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find Pierre Lees-Melou, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Paris SG will have a throw-in.
15' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

14' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
13' CHANCE! Steve Mounie finds Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
11' Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) commits a foul and Jerome Brisard immediately signals a free kick.
9' Dangerous play by Mahdi Camara (Brest). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Excellent touch by Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
7' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) makes a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Kylian Mbappe, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
5' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Marco Bizot makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.

3' Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

3' A sweet pass finds Kang-In Lee (Paris SG) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Marco Bizot is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.

3' Paris SG exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. The ball is out of play. Brest will take a throw-in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris SG will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
